question.text: A Qualified RTA (QRTA) servicing Mutual Funds investors must have Investor Service Centers in at least how many cities based on investor population?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, QRTAs servicing Mutual Funds investors must have Investor Service Centers in at least 100 cities based on the investor population pertaining to the Mutual Funds clients they service. The Trap: 50 or 75 cities may seem adequate for national coverage, but the SEBI requirement specifically sets the threshold at 100 cities. Note: QRTAs are also expected to maintain technical capacity for twice the peak transaction load and to conduct annual stakeholder/investor satisfaction surveys.
